# Thiago Macedo Mendes

> Computer Science student (UNIR) and IT Technician (IFRO) focused on software development and IT infrastructure. Experience working as a researcher for the GPMecatrônica and Gotec groups, and in IT infrastructure at Censipam. Skilled in TypeScript, Python, Java, Rust, PHP, React, Next.js, and databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB). Seeking a Software Development internship to apply my technical background to real-world projects.

## Experience & Research
- **IFRO - Federal Institute of Rondônia** (Jan 2025 - Dec 2025): Administrative Assistant. Outsourced contractor at the GPMecatrônica Research Group, in partnership with Belém Rio Segurança Ltda. Developed web applications (Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, oRPC) for internal GPMecatrônica projects. Contributed to robotics activities and the production of scientific papers for the group. Performed technical support, hardware maintenance, and environment standardization using Docker and Nix.
- **Censipam** (Aug 2023 - Oct 2024): IT Intern. Maintained the IT infrastructure for Censipam (Ministry of Defense). Performed hardware maintenance (assembly, diagnostics) and installed operating systems. Configured IP telephony network points within the building's infrastructure and provided technical support to internal users.
- **IFRO - Federal Institute of Rondônia** (Feb 2024 - Jul 2024): Scientific Researcher. Research fellow at the Technological Solutions Research Group (GoTec), focusing on web system development. Contributed to the development of the "Innovation Radar" web solution, working on front-end and back-end (TypeScript, ReactJS, Laravel, PHP, MySQL). Utilized Docker for containerization and Storybook for component documentation.
- **IFRO - Federal Institute of Rondônia** (Sep 2023 - Feb 2024): Voluntary Researcher. Voluntary researcher at the Technological Solutions Research Group (GoTec), focusing on technical training in web development (TypeScript, ReactJS, Laravel, PHP). Assisted with the initial architecture of the "Innovation Radar" project. Represented GoTec at scientific dissemination events, including presentations at Expo Favela.

## Featured Projects
- **toof-os** (https://github.com/o-thiago/ToofOS): Declarative NixOS configuration built for the DACC Station on Raspberry Pi 4.
- **gpm-cards** (https://github.com/o-thiago/gpm-cards): Web platform for member profiles and card generation for GPMecatrônica.
- **sqlx-conditional-queries-layering** (https://github.com/o-thiago/sqlx-conditional-queries-layering): Declarative macro library in Rust for composing SQLx queries.
- **Innovation Radar**: Web platform for tracking innovation initiatives and research IP at IFRO.
